entries.en: The news is talking about how[n]Shido won by a landslide...

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: ...There, they announced the poor health[n]of their leader, Masayoshi Shido.

entries.speaker: Newscaster
entries.en: As such, the special Diet session was[n]postponed, along with Shido's[n]inauguration as prime minister.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Postponed?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They should be firing him!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And wait, "poor health"?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This is completely different from what[n]my sister told us...

entries.speaker: Languid Man
entries.en: I heard he barely slept during the election[n]campaign. I don't blame him.

entries.speaker: Worried Man
entries.en: He's not going to step down now, is he?[n]Will this country be fine without Shido?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: How can people still believe in him?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What the heck!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are being treated[n]like, well... like they never existed!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Goodness...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: "No link among the 'change of heart'[n]incidents, only coincidental psychiatric[n]disorders"...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: "The Phantom Thieves only used those[n]rumors to their advantage"...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is preposterous... Who would believe[n]such things?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But the person saying this is a famous[n]researcher.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: And even the ministry is saying that's how[n]they determined the situation too...

entries.speaker: Carefree Man
entries.en: When's Shido gonna make a comeback?

entries.speaker: Bombastic Man
entries.en: Honestly, I don't think anyone else but[n]Shido can handle times like these.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What's going on? No matter how you[n]look at it, this isn't normal.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah... It's as if the people in reality have[n]become distorted...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What's happening here worries me.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But the only thing we can do right now is[n]wait and see what happens...
